Calculation Modes (MODE)

Three primary modes: COMP, STAT (eight sub-types), and VERIF.

keys
MODE

Press MODE to choose the calculation environment. STAT opens a model picker (1-VAR plus seven regressions). VERIF evaluates equality/inequality statements as TRUE or FALSE.

KeyModePurpose
1COMPGeneral arithmetic, surds, fractions, transforms
2STAT1-VAR + seven bivariate regressions
3VERIFTRUE/FALSE verification of relations

Mode pages

  • COMPDefault mode for arithmetic, trig, logs, fractions, sexagesimal, Pol/Rec, FACT, and exact surds.
  • STATStatistics editor with 1-VAR (including quartiles) and seven paired regression models.
  • VERIFTest equalities and inequalities; result is TRUE or FALSE.
